summary:
Plan of w164 (supervision r91-r97, r66) written. Eight accepted scenarios red (undefined steps, then missing code); r66 green and kept green.
Decisions: the integrate brief names a drafts path in its run directory, and on every ending its tree is copied into the stage directory's drafts/ and committed (r91); the change list is the result field `changes`, one entry for each capability with adds/changes/removes ids (r92); missing or empty means no change list, which is an error naming the round, with the drafts kept (r96); a malformed one is an unreadable result (r86-r88); one drafted proposal for each capability, named after it, all in the round's closing commit (r92); a started initiative with neither node gets an integrate round, with no start transition (r93); pull_through gives no review and no measure without work-items (r94, r97); one cross-initiative lock for integrate, apply and formulate rounds (r95).
New modules: scripts/supervise_change.py (plus a CLAUDE.md row) and tests/scenarios/supervision_integrate_steps.py. Dropped from the research set: supervise_review.py, supervise_worker.py, the skill and supervision_world.py.
Broken test: the r84 step second_not_refused asserts exit 0, which r93 and r96 rule out; it is rewritten to assert no refusal over uncommitted .shop/work/.
